_why: Panels this pipeline cannot derive. The analyzer has no window and reports over whole histories up to the pin, so a stretch-scoped count is read by hand; it is declared here with the command that produces it so a chart drawn from it is re-derivable, and is coloured and labelled as declared rather than derived wherever it is drawn.
